device.basis: On-chip HDMI transmitter. After the hot-plug status word reports a sink, the stock HDMI task opens this instance: event and status words at +0x7090/+0x7094 with enables at +0x7098/+0x709c, sink sense at +0x7008, the DDC request at +0x7a80 with its status at +0x7a84 and a 64-word FIFO at +0x7c00 for EDID and SCDC transfers. Its interrupt is INTID 287.
